title: Research: certify the S4 subspace-cut boundary
body:
## Summary

```diff
 mixed S4 tuple (2143,3142,4231,2143), prices (2,1,2)
 coordinate-cut cone:                                      20
+ all natural4 subspaces and binary edge6 subspaces alone:  18, sharply
+ add these subspaces to the old coordinate cone:           20, sharply
 separate scalar words:                                   21
```

This closes a specified part of PR2998's arbitrary-subspace handoff. The natural-module inequality holds over every field. Valid binary-word cuts use characteristic two; the edge-module theorem covers F2 only. Each cut uses one module copy uniformly over every scalar role. Coupled-copy subspaces and larger representations remain open. The actual circuit optimum remains 20 or 21.

Only `research/s4-subspace-cut-boundary/` is added. Credit Arham Tahir/PR2998, Adam Gall/PR1941, Ross Richardson/PR1966/1989 and the retained tariff/register-model lineage.

## Evidence

- Before: PR2998 excluded arbitrary subspace cuts from its coordinate-cone theorem. After: an all-field natural proof and a complete binary edge proof establish exact module bound `4 p1+2 p2+4 p3` for all nonnegative prices. The enlarged cone stays `8 beta+4 alpha` for `0<=alpha<=beta`.
- Code-disjoint span-extension and RREF/rank engines agree on every one of 2,892 binary subspaces, all profiles and complete inventory hashes. The second also checks 212 ternary and 1,120 quinary natural subspaces as corroboration, without treating them as binary-word certificates.
- Six optimized behavioral groups, registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, Ruff, exact committed-byte/source-history checks and unchanged Git-free committed-export replays on CPython 3.12.15 and 3.15 pass.
- Replay: `python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/s4-subspace-cut-boundary`. Source baseline and publication commit are `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c` and `8ed0087a755f70393bc384c09f16f4484615be05`.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2570#discussioncomment-19008934).

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: package.

This is a scoped proof-method obstruction, with author checks and no human or proof-kernel review claimed. It supplies no formal circuit optimum, native/physical/compiler admission, supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier update. Frozen predecessors and shared code are unchanged. Hosted CI remains separate from local verification.
